kapak.alt: The audiometric criterion in Meniere's disease

youtube.baslik: What must the audiogram show in the criteria for Meniere's disease? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The Barany Society criteria look for an audiometrically documented loss at two adjacent frequencies below two thousand hertz; in this loss, the bone conduction threshold of the affected ear must be at least 30 dB worse than the other ear's. In the example case, at 250 and 500 Hz right bone conduction is 40 and left is 10 dB; the difference is 30 dB and the criterion is met. For this comparison, bone conduction must be correctly masked; weighing the criteria as a whole and making the diagnosis is the physician's job.
